## Overview

The goal of the project update is to document and get feedback on any changes to your research and/or work plan as originally proposed.

## Instructions

Your update should be no more than 2 pages, not including references or figures, with no larger than 11pt Arial font (or equivalent) and 1" margins. It should include:

- Any changes to your question, system, model, methods, data sources, or the regulations you will incorporate. Include your rationale for the changes (*e.g.* reacting to feedback on the proposal or an inability to find the data you proposed using).
- The status of the project timeline: which milestones in your work plan you have met and which you have not? If your timeline has changed, provide an updated timeline.
- Any change to who is leading which tasks or how you are coordinating, and why.
- References for any sources you didn't cite in the proposal, cited in the text where you use them.

## Format and Submission

- Include the name(s) of the project team at the top of the PDF.
- Submit a PDF of the update to Gradescope by 9:00 PM on the due date.
